notes:
Overview:
- Mid-market B2B SaaS selling a hosted customer support assistant used by client helpdesks.
- Current stack: webhook-driven bot + light intent classifier. Looking to move to LLM-powered agent for dynamic answers + tool calls (CRM fetch, order API).

Primary asks for POC:
- Validate Hosted API streaming: first-token latency under 1.5s at 50-80 concurrent active sessions, realistic message sizes (avg 120 tokens context).
- Demonstrate function/tool calling with traceability: call order-api, attach ticket id, escalate flow.
- Evaluate streaming reliability over 72h window with synthetic peaks (burst to 500 sessions).
- Provide simple cost simulation: cost per active agent/day and per-100 agents/month for token pricing with streaming.

Performance targets & constraints:
- Customer insists on <1.5s first-token p95; internal preference <1.2s to win finance signoff.
- Streaming mandatory for UX (progressive answer display).
- Want fallbacks: if hosted capacity limited, route to smaller model with graceful degradation and audit logs.

Security & compliance:
- SOC2 required; admin SSO via SAML.
- EU data residency: will require either VPC or Private deployment for EU-region production later in 6-9 months.
- KMS support desired for Dedicated; initial Hosted should encrypt at rest with provider keys.

Commercial considerations:
- Estimated 120 active agents by month 12; seasonal spikes up to 600.
- If Hosted shows stable SLOs, they will sign annual ARR in band shown above; otherwise Dedicated procurement discussion begins.
- Sensitive to token pricing and streaming unit costs; asked for example invoice-level calc.

Customer sentiment & quotes:
- "Streaming is non-negotiable. If it feels slow we lose users." - Head of CX
- "Show us steady <1.2s first-byte at 50-80 concurrent and finance will clear." - CTO paraphrase

- 2025-09-18: Discovery call (AE Alex) - initial fit, use-case sketched
- 2025-10-10: Technical walkthrough with SE (Samira) - discussed streaming + function calling patterns
- 2025-11-07: Product demo - showcased streaming UI, basic fallback routing
- 2026-01-20: Commercial & security prep call - agreed POC scope (ff_20260120_convopilot_kickoff)
- 2026-02-15: Performance expectations & POC plan - confirmed 72h perf run and synthetic load profile

Next actions (owners):
- SE Samira: deliver POC harness & test script by 2026-02-25.
- Infra: confirm hosted capacity class that can meet streaming SLOs and reserved slots for POC.
- Sales (Alex): send pricing example and draft MSA/DPA to legal.
